_comment: Tests to skip when running protoJS + protoCore (PROTOJS_USE_PROTO_EVAL=1) via tests/test262/runner/test262_runner.js. Paths are relative to the Test262 tests directory. Remaining skips: eval-code (3 — require strict-mode eval SyntaxError not yet propagated), global-code (1 — restricted global decl), identifier-resolution (1 — global undefined assignment), statements/using (2 — TDZ for 'using' keyword). Phase 7 adds 11 entries: 5 TypedArray-resizable-buffer tests (need full TypedArray support) and 6 for-of/dstr tests (need destructuring iterator support). Module-code (39), line-terminators (7), and import (3) tests were removed after Phase 6 Step 1+2 fixes. built-ins/Object/defineProperties/15.2.3.7-6-a-93-1.js and -93-3.js (2) are skipped because their verdict depends on the order in which the keys 'property' and 'property1' are enumerated: own string keys follow protoCore attribute (key-address) order, not creation order (docs/VM.md, oddities). On macOS that order differs between runs of the same binary (CI runs 40237571147 and 40238979889 failed -93-1 and -93-3 respectively), and on Linux both fail when 'property1' is created first.
